g.text: Detect primary face in each image
Extract 68 facial landmarks from each face
Add 8 boundary points around each image
Build a shared Delaunay triangle mesh
Compute frame count from duration and FPS
Choose interpolation alpha for current frame
Select matching triangle from the shared mesh
Map triangle vertices in image 1, image 2,
Blend the two warped triangle patches
Composite the blended patch into the frame
Clip and convert the completed frame
Encode streamed frames as MP4 video
